about_short_description.short_description: Sante is a healthcare organization that provides nursing, home care, palliative, rehabilitation, clinical, and therapy services.

product.name: Short-Term Skilled Nursing & Rehabilitation
product.description: Provides clinical and therapy care for patients recovering from various medical conditions and surgeries in a skilled nursing facility setting.

product.name: Home Health Services
product.description: Delivers skilled nursing and rehabilitation care to patients recovering at home from various medical conditions and surgeries.

product.name: Outpatient Therapy
product.description: Offers therapy services such as physical, occupational, and speech therapy to patients not requiring inpatient care.

product.name: Palliative Care
product.description: Provides symptom management and comfort care for patients with serious illnesses alongside curative treatments.

product.name: Hospice Care
product.description: Delivers end-of-life care focused on comfort and support for patients and their families in various settings.

product.name: Workers’ Compensation Care
product.description: Offers coordinated care and rehabilitation services for patients recovering from work-related injuries.
